Information about the bundled engine

Source: R/info.R
zuslothdb_info.Rd

Reports which SlothDB source the package was built from and how it was changed: the upstream repository and commit, and the patches applied to it, in order. A database file is tied to this commit.

Usage

zuslothdb_info()

Value

A list with elements engine ("SlothDB"), repository, commit (the full upstream commit hash), describe (the last upstream release before it, as "v0.2.7+"), patches (a character vector of patch file names, in the order they are applied) and threads (the engine's thread cap, an integer).

Examples

info <- zuslothdb_info()
info$commit
#> [1] "8180f215847015944c935f56f008d194e2c1494c"
info$patches
#> [1] "0001-mingw.patch"             "0002-no-process-output.patch"
#> [3] "0003-offline.patch"           "0004-threads.patch"          
#> [5] "0005-strftime-arity.patch"    "0006-compiler-warnings.patch"
#> [7] "0007-read-only.patch"
